To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) locally robust positive reductions are not closed under composition, (2) locally robust positive many-one reductions are not closed even under the identity function, (3) locally robust positive Turing reductions are not closed neither under composition, nor under the identity function.
